name: affiliate-check
title_zh: 联盟计划实时比价器，佣金和 Cookie 天数一眼看
tagline_zh: 查联盟计划不再开十个标签页。搜一次，佣金、Cookie 有效期、表现排行全出来，首查 2 秒，之后每次 0.1 秒。
tagline_en: Stop tab-hopping for affiliate research. One search shows commissions, cookie windows, and top performers. 2s.
desc_en: Live affiliate program data from openaffiliate.dev. Search programs, compare commissions, check cookie days, find top performers. Use when researching affiliate programs, comparing options, or checking program details. Persistent daemon with cache — first call starts server (~2s), subsequent calls ~100ms.
why_zh: 带缓存常驻服务，首次启动后查询快两个数量级。数据源统一，比手工翻官网靠谱，适合批量对比时反复横跳。
why_en: Cached daemon makes repeat queries ~20x faster. Single source beats manual site-hopping—built for iterative comparison.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 openaffiliate.dev 已收录的联盟项目；未收录的查不到。数据非实时抓取，依赖该源更新频率。
limit_en: Only covers programs listed on openaffiliate.dev; unlisted ones won't appear. Data freshness depends on that source. No payout thresholds or.
title_en: Live affiliate program comparator: commissions & cookie days
